population.intervention: Brief behavioral therapy for insomnia (BBTI) plus eszopiclone.
population.intervention_regimen: Eszopiclone 2 mg nightly.; Eszopiclone 2 mg nightly 30 min before bedtime for a 2-week period; BBTI administered individually by trained staff therapists.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment allocation to BBTI plus eszopiclone.; Veterans aged 18–65 years with PTSD (DSM-5 and CAPS-5 score ≥25) and COMISA (DSM-5 insomnia disorder and PSG-documented OSA with AHI ≥5/h) who were non-adherent to CPAP (<4 h/night), met protocol inclusion/exclusion criteria, and were randomized to BBTI plus eszopiclone. Analysis set: intention-to-treat.
population.population_time_frame: Enrolment January 4th, 2020, to December 28th, 2023; follow-up visits at 6 and 24 weeks post-randomization.

population.intervention: Brief behavioral therapy for insomnia (BBTI) alone.
population.intervention_regimen: BBTI administered individually by trained staff therapists; no eszopiclone.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment allocation to BBTI alone.; Veterans aged 18–65 years with PTSD (DSM-5 and CAPS-5 score ≥25) and COMISA (DSM-5 insomnia disorder and PSG-documented OSA with AHI ≥5/h) who were non-adherent to CPAP (<4 h/night), met protocol inclusion/exclusion criteria, and were randomized to BBTI-only. Analysis set: intention-to-treat.
population.population_time_frame: Enrolment January 4th, 2020, to December 28th, 2023; follow-up visits at 6 and 24 weeks post-randomization.

population.intervention: BBTI with or without initial 2-week eszopiclone.
population.intervention_regimen: Eszopiclone 2 mg nightly in the BBTI plus eszopiclone arm; no eszopiclone in the BBTI-only arm.; Eszopiclone 2 mg nightly 30 min before bedtime for 2 weeks in the combination arm; BBTI administered individually in both arms.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment allocation (BBTI plus eszopiclone vs BBTI-only); all analyses based on intention-to-treat.; Veterans aged 18–65 years with PTSD (DSM-5 and CAPS-5 score ≥25) and COMISA (DSM-5 insomnia disorder and PSG-documented OSA with AHI ≥5/h) who were non-adherent to CPAP (<4 h/night), met protocol inclusion/exclusion criteria, and were randomized to BBTI plus eszopiclone or BBTI-only. Analysis set: intention-to-treat.
population.population_time_frame: Enrolment January 4th, 2020, to December 28th, 2023; follow-up visits at 6 and 24 weeks post-randomization.
